title: PocketFish
summary: A quiet pocket aquarium for CardputerZero.
description:
A quiet pocket aquarium. One fish, a little water, and you.

Tap a key to drop a crumb at the matching spot in the water:

    4 5 6 7 8
    E R T Y U
    D F G H J
    Z X C V B

Your fish takes a moment to notice, then swims over to eat.
Feed your fish at least every 5 days! Otherwise...

Press tab to meet your fish in MyFish and look around.
The longer you stay, the more you'll find :).
